skills.body:
# Voice Agent (speech-to-speech dashboard agent)

The user has a real-time voice agent as a dashboard tab (**Dashboards → Voice Agent**). It connects the browser microphone straight to a speech-to-speech model (xAI Grok Voice, `grok-voice-latest`) over a WebSocket with a short-lived ephemeral token. No STT/TTS pipeline, no phone system. A call log is kept on the same tab.

## Check status

Run `ob-plugin-voice-agent-status` (installed on PATH). It prints JSON: `hasKey`, `keySource`, `provider`, `model`, `voice`, plus a `hint`. Never print any key value.

## If not configured (hasKey false)

The plugin reuses the shared xAI key from the Config page Keys tab automatically (slug `xai`). If `hasKey` is still false, guide the user, in their language:

1. Dashboard → Config page → Keys tab: add their xAI API key (slug `xai`) — this also serves other xAI features, or
2. Dashboard → Plugins tab → Voice Agent → Settings: paste the key in “xAI API key”, or fill the vault slug `xai-api-key` under Vault keys.
3. Re-run the status tool to confirm `hasKey: true` (`keySource` tells you where it was found).

## If configured

Tell the user to open **Dashboards → Voice Agent**. Normal use: press the round button, talk, press again to hang up. **Hands-free**: press the “Hands-free” button once — the agent connects, stays with you (talk, pause, it answers, reconnects on drops), until you press “Stop hands-free”. The first call asks for microphone permission. Speech runs continuously with server-side turn detection, so no push-to-talk is needed.

## When the user reports problems

- No sound: the tab or system is muted, or the configured `voice` name does not exist for the provider — try `eve`.
- Connects but never answers: check the key is a valid xAI API key (console.x.ai) and that the machine can reach `api.x.ai`.
- Session error in the page: check the model name in settings (`grok-voice-latest`).

## Language rule (mandatory)

Always answer the user in the language they are using — never a hardcoded default. The voice agent itself is instructed to auto-detect the caller's language and answer in it; only change that through the `instructions` setting, never by hardcoding a language in code.

## Notes

- Audio flows browser → provider directly (WebSocket, ephemeral token). The plugin server only mints tokens and keeps the call log, so calls keep working under load.
- The dashboard page detects the browser language for its UI labels (en/fr/es/de) — this is display convenience, not a behavior lock.
- Roadmap providers: OpenAI Realtime, Google Gemini Live (the `provider` setting is ready for new enum values).
